DDInter741.mechanism: The central nervous system (CNS) effects of flibanserin such as somnolence and fatigue may be potentiated by concomitant use of other agents with CNS depressant effects. The risk of CNS depression is increased if flibanserin is taken during waking hours or with alcohol or other CNS depressants.

DDInter784.mechanism: Additive central nervous system and cardiorespiratory depressant effects may occur when fospropofol or propofol is administered with other depressants such as sedative-hypnotic agents and narcotic analgesics.

DDInter981.mechanism: Anecdotal reports have implicated the concomitant use of general anesthesia and nonselective monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) as causing hypotension or hypertension. Analysis of these cases suggests that other contributing factors may have been involved (e.g., meperidine and sympathomimetic agents).
